exact_items: Promote the runtime-artifact envelope from a named schema file to a clearly stated common field contract in Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md.
FileManager.md still states one canonical open contract, but later addenda already require a second category of opens for runtime artifacts by artifact_id.

FileManager’s future OpenArtifact-style flow should resolve by artifact_id for the artifact object, related runtime attempt/evidence lineage, and related Source Control / GitHub / Docker / Kubernetes surface when relevant
keep OpenFile { path... } for canonical workspace-file opens; add a second canonical open contract for identity-native objects, e.g. OpenSubject { subject_id, target_group?, open_mode?, location? }
path-based open remains for repo/workspace files; identity-based open is the canonical entrypoint for runtime artifacts, attempt/evidence/safe-point/remediation reports, preview/document hybrids

Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md calls artifact_id, run_id, thread_id, task_id, linked_artifact_id, and logical_artifact_id the canonical ID set, but that set is still missing the attempt-native/runtime attribution fields.
attempt-scoped evidence by attempt_id and runtime artifacts by artifact_id mean the docs have already outgrown a path-only open contract
there is currently no canonical OpenArtifact/OpenSubject contract even though multiple docs implicitly need it.
